question: HM Amit Shah releases “The Emergency Diaries”. The book focuses on which leader’s role during the Emergency?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• HM Amit Shah releases “The Emergency Diaries”, book chronicles PM Modi’s role in fight against emergency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Union Home Minister Amit Shah** released the book **‘The Emergency Diaries – Years That Forged a Leader’** in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
The book explores **Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s** role during the **1975 Emergency**, when he was a **young RSS Pracharak**.

 
 
• 
 
It portrays **Modi’s resistance to the Emergency** and support for **democratic ideals**.

 
 
• 
 
The launch was part of **Samvidhan Hatya Diwas 2025**, marking the **50th anniversary** of the **Emergency**.

 
 
• 
 
During the event, **Amit Shah flagged off the ‘Loktantra Zindabad Yatra’**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Yatra** aims to raise **awareness about constitutional values**, **democratic rights**, and the **lessons from the Emergency**.

 
 
• 
 
It will **travel across India**, engaging citizens in **democracy education**.
